item.title: Hunter harvests legendary 'Cactus Jack' buck in Missouri
item.description: PIERCE CITY, Mo. — After three years of close calls and careful watching, Luke Beaty finally harvested the buck he’d been chasing — an unusually antlered whitetail known among locals as “Cactus Jack.” Beaty, a Lawrence County hunter, first spotted the deer while driving home from church during archery season in November 2025. item.title: Significant winter storm and cold taking shape
item.description: An arctic front will bring dangerously cold weather and potentially snow to the region this weekend, with temperatures struggling to warm out of the single digits and wind chills remaining below zero.
